paragraphs.text: New API gateway for DeepSeek Harness: multi-channel models, quota, image and video generation
# New API Provider
English · 中文
A New API gateway workbench for DeepSeek Harness: several gateways with one active at a time, per-ga
teway model lists and parameter overrides, quota, and image and experimental video generation.
## Preview
| Model capabilities | Fetch models |
| **Model editor** | **Sidebar quota** |
The screenshots render this plugin's real components and stylesheet with sample data; gateway names,
URLs and amounts are examples. The UI follows the DSH theme, so colours adapt to your skin and dark
and amounts are examples. The UI follows the DSH theme, so colours adapt to your skin and dark mode.
## Install
Requires **DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or newer** (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2) and Node.js 22.19+.
Install `dsh-newapi-provider` with DSH's plugin manager, then refresh the page and open **Settings →
New API Provider**. No separate web server is needed.

1. **Add gateway** — name, New API site URL, calling token.
2. **Fetch models** — read what the gate

way lists, select the ones you want.
3. **Activate the gateway** — this plugin's model route now ser

the ones you want.
3. **Activate the gateway** — this plugin's model route now serves those models.
The token is stored in the DSH credential service, never in the gateway configuration, and is never
sent back to the browser.
## Features
- Several gateways, exactly one active; each keeps its own URL, credential reference, model list and

model overrides.
- Channel-scoped model management: fetch what a gateway lists, choose which models

appear in DSH, test one model, remove with undo, add models the gateway does not list.
- Capability
data from models.dev (context window, output cap, modalities, reasoning), correctable per model, wi

th an optional per-model upstream name mapping.
- Token quota in the settings summary and at the sid

ebar foot, plus the account balance when the token is allowed to query it.
- Image generation saved
as durable DSH attachments with a generation history; experimental video through the unified `/v1/vi
deos` interface with background polling and restart recovery.
## Gateways and quota
1. **Test connection** reads the model list only and does not make paid model calls; it also shows t

he gateway version and model counts.
2. **Activate** switches every subsequent call made through thi

s plugin, or tick "activate after saving".
3. Switching never rewrites other adapters or your defaul

t provider.
4. Submitted video tasks keep their originating gateway and are never polled on a newly
Submitted video tasks keep their originating gateway and are never polled on a newly activated one.
Quota details:

- Quota comes from `GET /api/usage/token/` (note the trailing slash).
- Amounts are converted with `
/api/status` (`quota_per_unit`, `quota_display_type`, `usd_exchange_rate`), never the top-up price.

- A token that allows user-quota queries also reports the account balance.
- An unlimited token show

s used quota instead of a meaningless negative remainder.
- Both numbers are the site's own; a prese
nt catalog or balance does not prove an upstream channel can serve a model.
The sidebar shows the active gateway's name and amount, with a health dot; click it to refresh. It c
ollapses to a status dot when the sidebar is a rail.
## Per-gateway model lists
Each gateway keeps an independent list, even when two gateways point at the same site with the same
ateway keeps an independent list, even when two gateways point at the same site with the same token:
- **Model capabilities tab** has a gateway picker; the active gateway is marked and its list edits a

pply to that gateway only.
- **Fetch models** reads the gateway catalog with a search box plus statu
s (new / added / removed upstream) and kind filters, grouped by kind; filtering only changes what is
listed, never the current selection. The list scrolls on its own and the action bar stays in view.
- **Remove** only removes the model from this gateway; custom parameters can be kept and the removal

can be undone briefly.
- **Add manually** is for models the gateway can serve but does not list.
-
Gateways created in current versions start with an empty list; channels saved before the feature exi
sted stay in automatic mode (all gateway models) until their first edit, which materialises the list
from what the gateway currently lists.
## Testing models
- **Chat models**: one minimal streaming request. The result remembers success, total latency, first
packet time and a redacted error. A stream that only sends `[DONE]` counts as a failure, because it

carries no protocol response.
- **Image/video models**: a real generation, so each test asks for co
nfirmation first. Image tests show a preview when the URL is safe to embed; a signed URL is recorded

as generated without exposing it.
- **Batch test** covers the chat models currently filtered, three
at a time. Stopping prevents queued requests; requests already sent still finish and may be billed.
- Tests are billed requests: chat tests send a tiny completion, image/video tests generate.
## Model names and mapping
- **Local model id**: the stable id used by sessions and the model list; never changed by the editor

.
- **Display name** (`name`): label only.
- **Upstream model name** (`upstreamModel`): the `model`
actually sent. Empty means the local id. Mapping is one hop and applies to chat, image generation, i

mage edits, video and model tests.
- The editor previews the mapping, resolves automatic protocol/ca
pabilities/pricing from the mapping target, and lets input modalities and reasoning follow the catal
og or be pinned. Reset clears every override including the mapping.
Capability data is a hint, not proof: a relay may list a model and still fail to serve it.
## Thinking levels
Vendors do not agree on reasoning levels, so each model resolves its own set instead of every reason
ing model showing the same five:
| Vendor / model | Levels offered | Notes |
| Claude adaptive thinking (Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable) | low / medium / high / xhigh / max | no `min

imal`, no `off` |
| Older Claude (budget based) | off / minimal / low / medium / high | mapped to to

ken budgets |
| GPT-5.1+ / GPT-6 | off / low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `off` is sent as `none`

, no `minimal` |
